description: This is a Java source file defining the DashboardController class, which is a REST controller responsible for handling requests to the dashboard endpoint. It interacts with the OrderService to fetch sales data, order counts, and recent orders, and returns a DashboardResponse object with this data.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: REST controller for dashboard-related endpoints, providing aggregated sales and order data.

methods.name: getDashboardData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /dashboard, retrieves sales and order data for today, and returns a DashboardResponse object.
